response.justification: While Bogdan is a highly experienced and technically proficient individual contributor with strong backend and distributed systems expertise, he lacks the executive leadership background required for a CTO role. There is no evidence on his resume of scaling engineering organizations, managing external delivery partners, or directing high-stakes fintech infrastructure at an executive level.
strengths: Extensive hands-on experience with backend architecture, microservices, and low-latency systems.
Recent exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tooling.
Demonstrated entrepreneurial drive through founding and maintaining an open-source data platform.
concerns: Zero executive-level leadership experience; background is strictly in Senior/Staff individual contributor roles.
No demonstrated track record of scaling engineering teams from 10 to 30+ people.
Lacks deep experience architecting AI-driven fintech infrastructure for high-stakes regulated environments.
